channel.title: The Deal With Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly
channel.desc: When sports, business and culture collide, there's often a deal to be made. Join Alex Rodriguez and Bloomberg correspondent Jason Kelly as they get the inside track from corporate titans, sports champions and game-changing entrepreneurs on investing, strategy, reinvention and the ones that got away; a Bloomberg Podcasts and Bloomberg Originals series that's passionate, relaxed, insightful and inspirational. If you think you know these icons, prepare to be surprised.
